svg.title: A1. Application Overview - Read Steps 1 to 6

g.text: A1. Application Overview - Read Steps 1 to 6
Product reads are public; ordering requires authentication.
Customers only receive their own order history.
Admins can edit the catalog and list all orders.
Hiding frontend controls is not the security boundary.
PostgreSQL data persists in a named volume.
Known demo accounts are seeded only by the dev profile.
Sessions currently live in backend memory, not a shared store.
Responses return along the request path.
See A2 for numbered sign-in and order interactions.
Keycloak, image uploads and cluster deployment remain planned.
